dog.description_text:
What’s more gorgeous than a marbled red coat and emerald-green eyes? NOTHING! Dancer is a 7-year old, 8-pound beauty queen who is very sweet, totally mellow around other cats and dogs, and seems to be most active at night when no one else is watching her.

Dancer is still adjusting to her new surroundings, so her true personality is not yet on full display. What’s clear, though, is she has a heart of gold, and just needs the kindness of humans to gain her trust. With the help of treats, Dancer is loosening up and realizing it’s safe - and fun - to come out and nosh on yummy stuff! She also loves wet food and isn’t the least bit fussy at mealtime.

As far as toys go, Dancer really enjoys watching laser pointers. She also likes to gaze out the kitchen window and watch the morning birds. A keen observer, Dancer takes it all in.

Dancer is fully litter-box trained and keeps her bathroom area neat and clean. This sweet, petite angel has come a long way in a relatively short time. And she doesn’t ask for much. Just a patient person willing to give her the time and space to blossom and grow into the best version of herself.

Wanna give this fluff-ball a second chance at love? Dancer so deserves to be cared for and cherished. And when you see her heart begin to open up, and her fears gradually slip away? Gosh, it’ll be soooo worth it!!!

If you would like to adopt this wonderful cat, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
